scope: Finite cutoff and fixed positive floor for the hash-pinned L=16 A1 six-real production model; common real-even mutually orthogonal one-shot sharp shells; regular bounded cylindrical strict-past controls; inhomogeneous H2 physical control fields; and 0<kappa<1 for the centered-form lemma. theorem.nonlinear_harvest: For the exact reachable current increment delta_j(h), H_eta,j(w)=||w||^2/2-inf_h{||w+delta_j(h)||^2/2+eta||h||^2} is nonnegative and R_j(h)+eta||h||^2>=-H_eta,j(w). For delta=Lh it equals <s,(L^*L+2eta I)^-1s>/2.
theorem.full_score: For E(u)=sum_i int Du^T B(u)Du/2, the exact shell derivative is sigma_j=G_j^*[B(u_j)Du_j]+K_j^*q(u_j,Du_j)/2. Its square sum is at most A0[beta0 M6^2 Q6+(beta1/2)M6 Q6^2]^2||phi||_6^6.
theorem.gaussian_tail: At the uncontrolled terminal-backward Gaussian base, same-point value--derivative independence and explicit lattice covariance traces give E||ell_j||^2<=C_ell/N_(j-1) and E||m_j||^2<=C_m/N_(j-1)^2, so every predictable infinitesimal feedback tail is summable.
theorem.cat0_tip_secant: For maps U0,U1 into the complete aggregate CAT(0) cone, E(U_t)+t(1-t)||grad d(U0,U1)||_2^2/2<=(1-t)E(U0)+tE(U1), including the cone tip. A separate finite first variation at a general tip-touching pair is not claimed.
theorem.physical_distance: The production pullback bound B_e(X)<=beta0|Z|^2I yields d_g(Phi_e(X),Phi_e(X+a))<=sqrt(beta0)(|Z|+|a_Z|/2)|a|<=sqrt(beta0)(|X|+|a|)|a|, floor-uniformly through tip crossings.
theorem.centered_form: For Pi(a)=sum_j S_(j-1)(a_j tensor a_j), X=sum||a_j||_H2^2, Y=||(sum|a_j|^2)^(1/2)||_6^6, and theta=(1+kappa)/2, ||Pi(a)||_H^(1+kappa)<=C X^theta Y^((1-theta)/3). Pairing Q in H^(-1-kappa) and weighted Young costs eta X+zeta Y+C eta^[-3(1+kappa)/(2(1-kappa))] zeta^-1/2 ||Q||^[3/(1-kappa)].
theorem.scalar_schur: For f(u,p)=u^2p^2 and |a|<=theta|u|, the exact endpoint-derivative completion leaves at worst -[(3-2theta)/(1-theta)^2]a^2p^2. Near the tip the tangent must be dropped; retaining it globally is unbounded below.
theorem.architecture_no_go: Absolute integration of the inserted-shell full-score bound produces x^3y+delta x^2y^2+delta^2xy^3+delta^3y^4, which cannot meet arbitrary eta y^2+zeta x^6+C allocations. The full nonlinear remainder also contains [M(z+a)-M(z)-DM(z)a]^T y; only its second product term has N^-3/2 shell decay.
theorem.gauge_beat: A strict-shell gauge-null affine phase beat has zero initial moment-map score but an exact negative-quadratic/positive-quartic J-sector secant. Its CM threshold AC of order eta N^2 and Gaussian tail remain summable after N^3 multiplicity, so it is not a production counterexample.
